one_sentence_story: Discovered by accident in a 1976 British dubbing room, the McGurk Effect proved that 98% of adults hear a brand-new third sound ('DA') when 'BA' audio meets 'GA' lip movements — because the temporal lobe fuses sight and sound before conscious hearing even forms.
so_what_for_you: In noisy restaurants, classrooms, or critical medical conversations, always face your listener in clear light — letting their visual system read lip timing gives an effortless clarity boost equivalent to cranking the volume up.
